title: Cancellation Fee by Months Held, Northgate Protect Accident Plans
content:
The cancellation fee on a Northgate Protect Accident-tier cancellation refund depends on how many whole months the plan has been held since its purchase date:

- **24 whole months or more:** the lesser of the long-held rate of 0 percent times the plan price kept and the long-held cap of $0.00, so no fee is charged;
- **6 whole months or more but fewer than 24:** the lesser of the mid-held rate of 10 percent times the plan price kept and the mid-held cap of $15.00;
- **fewer than 6 whole months:** neither held-months rate applies.

The plan price kept is the plan's one-time charges less any refunds already booked on the plan; the months are whole calendar months from the plan purchase date to today.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical plan price kept of $200.00)

| Whole months held | Fee under this clause |
|---|---|
| 5 | Neither held-months rate applies |
| 6 | The lesser of $20.00 and $15.00: $15.00 |
| 23 | $15.00 |
| 24 | $0.00 |

*Hypothetical:* with a plan price kept of $120.00 held 9 whole months, 10 percent is $12.00, below the $15.00 cap, so the fee is $12.00.
